WallSlateRock.stylePrompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: seamless stylized game terrain albedo texture, opaque square 1024 x 1024.
Reference image 1 is the existing cream ground rock texture: preserve its chunky painted faceted rendering style, restrained surface detail and readable game-scale marks. Reference image 2 is the cliff tile: use ONLY its cool gray SIDE rock tone and broad irregular slab shapes, ignore the yellow top, lighting and white background.
Create a new rock texture variant for splat painting on flat cliff tops: cool neutral slate gray, mean diffuse RGB around 118,123,129; broad angular rounded rectangular rock plates, mostly horizontal and staggered, unequal widths and heights, a few squarer pieces. Broad calm painted interiors with subtle facets and sparse narrow dark seams. Values and saturation must match the medium-gray cliff rock, not pale cream; no overall brightness gradient. Colors are matte diffuse albedo, no cast shadows, gloss, perspective or directional highlights.
Fill the entire image with rock, completely seamless repeat left/right and top/bottom including matching rock shapes crossing those edges. One flat top-down texture, no border, no text, no sheet layout, no objects, no grass, no moss. Keep detail restrained, like the source game's ground artwork. The whole image repeats across a 4-by-4-tile area.

Make most main stones broadly rectangular horizontally oriented slabs, roughly 2 to 3 times wider than tall. Uneven staggered courses with irregular lengths, a few squarer stones and chipped rounded corners. Avoid the current predominantly round or tall oval flagstones; avoid a regular brick grid. Narrow subdued seams, broad quiet painted interiors, no new microdetail. Match the horizontal irregular chunky segments of the game cliff wall. WallSlateRock.heightPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. WallMoss.stylePrompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: seamless stylized game terrain albedo texture, opaque square 1024 x 1024.
Reference image 1 is the game's current ground grass texture. Keep its broad painterly low-poly facets, soft polygonal color patches and sparse readable accents, but transform the subject into a dense carpet of darker green moss for flat cliff-top splat painting.
Use muted dark forest green with subdued olive/gray-green accents; mean diffuse RGB around 67,92,54. Clearly darker and less yellow than the current grass. Flat cushioned interlocking moss patches of varied sizes, subtle soft-edged chunky facets, occasional small moss nubs, very sparse fern-like moss tufts. Mostly quiet areas so blending with gray rock is readable. No stones, exposed dirt, flowers or tall grass blades. Matte diffuse color only: no cast shadows, no sun direction, no gloss or brightness gradient; no photographic fibers or noisy microdetail.
Fill the image edge-to-edge with moss, seamless repeat left/right and top/bottom with matching patch shapes crossing all edges. One flat top-down texture, no border, no text, no sheet layout, no objects. Whole image repeats across a 4-by-4-tile area.
WallMoss.heightPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Produce the registered HEIGHT SOURCE for this moss albedo texture, grayscale only, flat top-down, exactly the same square composition and pixel alignment: preserve all moss patches, tuft clusters, nubs, depressions and edge crossings in their original positions and sizes. White means higher, black lower, medium-gray base around128. Moss cushion interiors slightly elevated, creases and recesses lower, small moss clumps rounded-height rises. Remove color and diffuse lighting variation; do not translate green pigment variations directly into large hills. Smooth broad quiet relief with very restrained fine grain. This is technical PBR height data, not a lit grayscale photograph or a shaded render. No shadows, highlight lighting, text, borders, sheet layouts or extra objects. Seamless opposite edges. Square1024x1024.
